description: Decision Entropy: A New Theory for Representing Uncertainty in Managing Natural Hazard Risks is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Robert Gilbert, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). In the last several years, offshore wind jacket structures have been introduced into the waters of the United States. Previous experience in developing jacket structures for the oil and gas industry in the Gulf of Mexico has allowed transition for use with offshore wind structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: pipe piles, jacket structure, offshore wind, cyclic loading, sand, aging. Published 2021-06-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
